source_snapshot.items: Fabric Topodiff setup and trial run in UFM - Fabric Topodiff
source_snapshot.procedure: Capture topology1 with ibnetdiscover, physically unplug one cable, capture topology2, compare with ibtopodiff using the stated GUID and optional CX7 serial/port selector.
source_snapshot.criteria: The comparison reports the removed cable and permits rapid physical localization.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL/CONFLICTING; recognizes generic Topodiff evidence but attaches an unrelated subnet-merger/deploy risk and omits the deliberate physical fault and recovery.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/CHANGED; requires isolated physical scope, exact selectors, qualified operator, visual evidence and restored fabric.

old_problem: The active record treated target GUIDs, cable labels, drain state and recovery deadlines as an unresolved review decision. NVIDIA defines ibnetdiscover as a full-fabric topology discovery whose output includes GUIDs, node types and ports; the remaining values are project/runtime bindings. ED-09 assigns the physical unplug/reconnect to a qualified human rather than blocking the review.
disposition_reason: The source method is technically complete once selectors are bound to an approved lab link. ED-05 retains IB-only coverage, ED-09 requires manual cable handling and real visual evidence, ED-15 requires exact-link and recovery oracles before PASS, and ED-18/ED-20 preserve complete state transitions and per-case analysis. Hard-coded selectors are applicability examples and may be used only when proven to identify the approved target.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row427 all 18 XLSX columns, same-row DeepSeek material, GPT V2/history3018 and adjacent row426 IBDiagnet plus row428 partial-memory cases.
Applied NVIDIA ibnetdiscover semantics: it discovers the full InfiniBand topology and reports GUIDs, node types, port numbers, LIDs and descriptions in the saved output.
Preserved both source ibtopodiff paths, including -g 0xa088c203002f72ec and optional H-946dae0300cf013a port 1, but made their use conditional on authoritative pre-test identity matching.
Kept the real physical unplug/localization coverage, added operator hold points and a third restored-state snapshot; a synthetic file edit cannot substitute.
Directly read next formal queue Compatibility row428 and verified its manifest identity; no cable, topology, UFM or DUT action ran.

test_case.test_name: Controlled InfiniBand cable removal localization by UFM Topodiff with full recovery proof
test_case.purpose: Prove that topology snapshots and ibtopodiff identify the exact approved physically removed IB cable/link and that reconnection restores the original fabric without collateral changes.
required_package: Approved isolated lab fabric, UFM/OFED/ibnetdiscover/ibtopodiff versions and OOB access
Authoritative switch/HCA GUID, node serial, local port, peer port and physical cable-label map
Approved redundant target link, drained workload/routing state and qualified physical operator
Applicability decision for literal GUID 0xa088c203002f72ec and optional H-946dae0300cf013a port 1 selectors
Project-approved allowed-delta set, link-recovery deadline and healthy route/service oracle
test_case.test_command: Verify versions and the GUID/port/peer/cable map, drain the approved redundant path, capture fabric health and hash topology1.ibnd from a successful full ibnetdiscover. At a recorded hold point a qualified operator photographs and removes only the approved labeled cable. Capture and hash topology2.ibnd, then run the source full ibtopodiff command with the verified -g selector and, when applicable, the source -s/-p focused command; preserve full stdout/stderr. Correlate the sole intended missing edge to both physical endpoints. Reconnect the same cable once, wait the approved deadline, capture topology3.ibnd and prove topology/routes/link/service return to baseline.
test_case.expected_result: The baseline snapshot covers the approved fabric; the fault snapshot differs by the exact two endpoints of the one removed cable; full and applicable focused Topodiff output localize that cable without unexplained extra deltas. After reconnection the link, routing, UFM health and third snapshot match the approved baseline oracle within the recovery deadline.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires authoritative selector-to-cable identity, real operator photo/timestamp, immutable pre/fault/recovery snapshots, the exact intended missing-edge match, no unapproved topology delta and complete restored-state proof. A diff against guessed or stale GUIDs, synthetic snapshot edits, absent visual evidence or incomplete recovery is INCONCLUSIVE or FAIL—not PASS.
safety_gate: Lab/maintenance window only; prove redundancy and drain jobs before any physical action
Maintain OOB access and never remove an unverified, sole management or sole fabric path
Use a qualified operator with explicit unplug and reconnect hold points; do not automate physical handling
Abort on unexpected partition/routing/job impact, reconnect the approved cable once, preserve logs and never auto-retry
expected_evidence: Tool versions, approved fabric identity and GUID/port/peer/cable-label trace matrix
Operator timestamp and real before/removed/reconnected cable photos
Hashed topology2.ibnd and complete full/focused ibtopodiff commands/stdout/stderr
Missing-edge-to-label reconciliation, hashed topology3.ibnd, recovery timing and post-health verdict
test_case.recovery: If the wrong link or unexpected fabric impact occurs, stop comparison work, have the operator reconnect the labeled cable immediately, preserve all topology/route/UFM evidence and verify link/routing/service restoration through OOB. Escalate if the approved recovery deadline is exceeded; do not unplug another cable or retry automatically.

source_conflict.reason: The rewrite removes DeepSeek's unrelated subnet-merger/deploy statement and restores the deliberate physical cable-removal Topodiff test.

blocked.reason: Tool semantics, method, safety and recovery are complete; exact fabric selectors and cable identity are mandatory project/runtime bindings.
